scopeLimit: This slice maps the 124-scenario public navigation browser assertions to their two exact workflow routes. It does not map every setup/static command in those workflows or complete TST-004. The development browser route excludes only the generated primary-page manifest because ARC-13 validates that exact file; no gate is removed and all other generated paths remain included.

scenarioModel.statement: 31 route/width combinations × 2 themes × 2 engines. The Viewer depth-2 20-case contract is separate and is not included in this count.

triggerDecision.reason: PR #415 changed the manifest catalog blob pin without changing public page outputs. The separate ARC-13 integrity workflow watches this exact manifest and validates primary-page compiler output and provenance.
triggerDecision.preservedCoverage: The development public navigation workflow still runs for source fragments, page templates, compiler, public HTML, shared browser assertions, and every other generated path; workflow_dispatch remains available.

executions.step: Verify 124 NAV-004 / NAV-005 behavioral scenarios across 2 engines
executions.scope: pull_request and push on development; workflow_dispatch without path or branch filters

executions.step: Verify 124 public navigation scenarios in Chromium and WebKit
executions.scope: pull_request targeting main only, for opened, reopened, synchronize, and ready_for_review

anchors: id+" active nav must match route (Viewer has none)"
id+" icon-only and visible theme control keeps its accessible name"

assertions.risk: A route exposes duplicated or stale navigation state, an incorrect active link, or an unnamed theme control.
assertions.state: Validated in light and dark themes across Chromium and WebKit.
assertions.fixture: Local static app on loopback; external browser traffic is blocked.

anchors: id+" narrow public page has no horizontal overflow"
id+" 291px header remains on one row"
id+" how-it-works title text stays visible inside the hero copy"

assertions.risk: The public header, contact action, or how-it-works hero overflows or becomes clipped at narrow widths.
assertions.state: Uses route-specific widths including narrow transition points and 320px; only the how-it-works hero text checks apply to that route.
assertions.fixture: Local static page routes with fixed 844px viewport height and reduced motion.

anchors: id+" keyboard activation focuses first link"
id+" keyboard order reaches contact after public navigation"

assertions.risk: Menu state, focus return, or reachable contact action diverges between pointer and keyboard use.
assertions.state: The open/close, Escape, pointer-outside, focus, and resize-preservation checks run when the relevant control is visible.
assertions.fixture: Browser interactions against loopback pages with no authenticated session.

assertions.risk: Viewer accidentally receives the public-page shell or loses its own first-level header and desktop navigation.
assertions.state: This shared 124-case suite covers Viewer first-level shell placement; it does not replace the separate 20-case depth-2 Viewer contract.
assertions.fixture: The /viewer/ local static route across the suite's three widths, two themes, and two engines.

anchors: id+" only selected card is expanded"
id+" selecting another card collapses previous"

assertions.risk: A skip link loses its target or the comparison disclosure allows multiple cards to remain expanded.
assertions.state: Checks the exact skip target and that selecting a second economy card collapses the first.

adjacentIndependentGate.boundary: Depth-2 Viewer geometry, links, theme and keyboard contract. It is independently scoped and not duplicated or counted by the shared 124-case suite.

exclusions: No workflow, trigger, path filter, condition, gate, product runtime, mask, Netlify setting, or Production state is changed by this crosswalk.
No runtime pass is inferred from source mapping; exact candidate-head workflow results remain pending.
